title: SWF: emit DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84) instead of tag 46 for shape tweens
description:
The SWF compiler emits DefineMorphShape (tag 46) for shape tweens. Flash 8 introduced DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84) which supports LineStyle2 stroke caps/joins/scaling identical to DefineShape4.

Shapes with LINESTYLE2 stroke attributes compiled via tag 46 lose their cap/join/scale settings in Ruffle because tag 46 uses the older LINESTYLE record format which has no cap/join fields.

Fix: upgrade packages/swf/src/morphshape.ts to emit tag 84 instead of tag 46 when the document targets SWF version 8+. The tag body for 84 is identical to 46 except the linestyle array uses LINESTYLE2 records (same as DefineShape4).

Acceptance: parse-back test in packages/swf/src/__tests__/shapes.test.ts or morphshape.test.ts verifies a shape-tween document emits tag 84 and the linestyle records include cap/join fields.
